stockCount.review.notFound: This count could not be found.
stockCount.review.matched: The count matches the stock ledger. Nothing to adjust.
stockCount.review.raised: An adjustment for this variance has been raised. Adjustment status: {{status}}.
stockCount.review.ledgerNote: The count never overwrites the system quantity. Raising an adjustment sends the variance for approval; stock moves only when another admin approves it.
stockCount.review.raiseConfirmBody: A count correction of {{variance}} will be sent for approval.
stockAdj.history.title: Adjustment History
stockAdj.request.title: Stock Adjustment Request
stockAdj.request.reasonPlaceholder: Why the stock needs adjusting (at least 5 characters)
stockAdj.request.note: Nothing changes on submit. The adjustment waits for another admin to approve it, and only then is it written to the stock ledger.
stockAdj.form.error.qty: Enter a quantity above zero in kg, with at most 3 decimals.
stockAdj.form.error.qtyAboveAvailable: You cannot remove more than the batch holds.
stockAdj.form.error.direction: This type can only remove stock.
stockAdj.form.error.reasonShort: Write a reason of at least 5 characters.
stockAdj.form.error.reasonLong: The reason can be at most 500 characters.
stockAdj.detail.title: Stock Adjustment
stockAdj.detail.notFound: This adjustment could not be found.
stockAdj.detail.pendingNote: Waiting for approval. Stock has not changed yet.
stockAdj.detail.approvedNote: Approved and written to the stock ledger.
stockAdj.detail.noApprovePermission: Another admin with approval rights decides this adjustment.
stockAdj.detail.approveConfirmBody: {{qty}} will be written to the stock ledger for batch {{batch}}.
stockAdj.error.selfApproval: You raised this adjustment, so another admin must approve or reject it.
stockAdj.error.state: This adjustment has already been decided. Refresh to see its status.
stockAdj.error.stockUnavailable: The batch no longer holds enough stock for this adjustment.
stockAdj.error.forbidden: You do not have permission to decide stock adjustments.
inventory.movementDetail.title: Movement Detail
inventory.movementDetail.notFound: This movement could not be opened. Go back to the stock ledger and tap it again.
inventory.movementDetail.ledgerNote: Ledger entries are never edited. A correction is recorded as a new movement.
inventory.allocation.fcfsNote: Online stock is first come, first served: a customer's cart holds stock from the Online bucket when they add it, and an order larger than the Online bucket's available stock is refused rather than taken from Reserve. Channel percentages are set by the Super Admin; this screen does not change them.
salesDirect.error.quoteStale: The quoted total is out of date. Check the new totals and confirm.
salesDirect.walkIn.nameRequired: Enter a name for the walk-in customer.
salesDirect.payment.cashInvalid: Enter a valid cash amount (e.g. 500 or 500.50).
